Jorna

Privacy Policy

Effective FILL: effective date

Jorna helps vendors run their event business — listings, contracts, signatures and payment tracking — and helps clients find and book them. This page explains what we collect to do that, who else sees it, how long we keep it, and what you can do about it. It is part of our Terms of Use.

Jorna is a project operated by Kabir Nagpal, an individual (the “Operator”, “Jorna”, “we”, “us”), who has not yet formed a company. Questions: jornaevents@gmail.com.

What we collect

WhatWhy
Account details — name, email, username, and optionally a phone number, age, city and profile photo To create your account, show you to the people you work with, and contact you about your bookings and contracts
Vendor profile — business description, category, service listings, prices, photos, travel radius, payment handles (such as Venmo or Zelle), and an Instagram username if you link one So clients can find you, book you and pay you. Listings are public. Payment handles are shown only to your clients
Public Instagram content — posts and images from an Instagram account a vendor links To fill out that vendor's profile. Only accounts a vendor links themselves
Client and event details — a client's name, email and phone, and the event's date, time, location and other details, entered by the vendor or the client To write, send and keep the contract, and to remind each side of what's due
Contracts and their history — the contract and any addenda or cancellation agreements, proposed changes, and a timeline of when each was sent, opened, changed, signed or declined So both sides have the same record of what was agreed and when
Signing records — described in the next section To show who signed, when, and that they agreed to sign electronically
Payment records — what's due and when, and “I've sent this” and “received” confirmations. Jorna does not process payments or see bank or card details To track payments and send reminders
Content you create — messages, reviews, photos you upload To run conversations and the reviews other people rely on
Planning assistant — the event details you type into it To suggest vendors and ideas (see below)
Google Calendar access — for vendors who choose to connect it To read your busy times so you don't get double-booked. You can disconnect at any time
Device and technical data — push notification tokens, IP addresses, browser type, and error reports To deliver notifications, keep the Services secure (for example, limiting repeated attempts), and fix problems

Records we keep when you sign

When a client opens a contract link, we record the time, their IP address and their browser and device information. When they sign a contract, addendum or cancellation agreement, we also record:

  • the full name they typed as their signature, and the time;
  • the email address we sent the one-time signing code to, and when they entered it;
  • their IP address and browser and device information at the moment of signing;
  • the exact wording of the consent to electronic records they agreed to;
  • a copy of the terms they signed, and when each signed copy was emailed.

We keep these so either side can show who signed, when, and what they agreed to, as the electronic-signature laws expect. They are sealed into the signed record with a digital fingerprint, so a later change can be detected. The signing code itself is stored only in scrambled (hashed) form and stops working after 10 minutes.

Both parties get these details. The signed PDF ends with a signing certificate that lists them, including the signer's IP address and device, and we email that PDF to both the client and the vendor. The vendor dashboard itself does not show IP addresses.

How the planning assistant uses your event

When you use the planning assistant, the details you enter — such as city, date, guest count, budget and style — are sent to a third-party artificial intelligence provider (currently OpenRouter) to suggest options. We do not send your name, email, phone number, messages or payment details. Do not type sensitive personal information into it.

Who we share it with

We do not sell your personal information, and we do not use it for advertising or cross-app tracking.

  • The other party to your contract — vendors see the client details on their contracts; clients see the vendor's contract, business details and payment handles; both receive the signed PDF and its signing certificate.
  • Other users — vendor listings and reviews are public; messages are seen by the people in the conversation.
  • Service providers that run Jorna for us, only for that purpose: Railway and Cloudflare (hosting), Supabase (sign-in and photo storage), Resend (email, including signing codes and signed copies), Firebase Cloud Messaging (push notifications), Google (Google sign-in and Calendar, if you use them), OpenRouter (the planning assistant), Apify (fetching linked Instagram accounts), and Sentry (error reports).
  • Legal reasons — if required by law, or to investigate fraud, abuse or a safety issue, or to protect the rights of users or Jorna.
  • A future company — when the Operator forms a company to run Jorna, your information and our records, including signed contracts, will transfer to it, as described in Section 18 of the Terms.

How long we keep it

  • Account and profile information — while your account exists. When you delete it, we delete it or remove what identifies you, except as below.
  • Signed contracts and their signing records — for FILL: retention period (e.g. 7 years) after the event date, even if either party deletes their account, because both parties may need them to prove or enforce the agreement.
  • Unsigned, declined or voided contracts — while the vendor's account exists.
  • Signing codes — hashed, and unusable after 10 minutes.
  • Server logs and error reports — FILL: log retention (e.g. 90 days).

Your choices

  • Delete your account. In the app's account settings. Signed contracts are kept as described above.
  • Correct your details. In your account settings, or ask the vendor to update the details on your contract.
  • Get a copy. Email us for a copy of your information. Either party can also ask for a free paper copy of a signed contract.
  • Withdraw consent to electronic records for future contracts by emailing us. It does not undo anything already signed.
  • Notifications. Turn them off in your device settings at any time.
  • Google Calendar. Disconnect it from your vendor calendar screen.

Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights — to access, correct, delete, or object to certain processing of your information. Email us and we will respond within 30 days.

Children

Jorna is not intended for children. You must be at least 18 to use the Services.

Security

Traffic is encrypted in transit. Passwords and signing codes are stored hashed, never in readable form. Signed records carry a digital fingerprint so a later change can be detected. No system is perfectly secure, but if a breach affects your information we will tell you as the law requires.

Changes

If we change this policy we'll update the date at the top. If a change is material, we will tell you by email or in the Services before it takes effect.
